app.tagline: Virtual Scrum Master for the daily stand-up

status.title: Environment status
status.description: This screen exists to check that the web application talks to the API. The product screens arrive with their own stories.
status.error_hint: Start the API with make api and try again.

selector.title: Select your team
selector.failed: Your teams could not be loaded. Try again later.
selector.empty: You do not belong to any team yet.

problems.not_authenticated: Your session is not valid or has expired. Sign in again.

create.title: Create team

errors.too_long: The name cannot be longer than {{ max }} characters.

create.defaults_hint: The team will be created in support mode with English as its language. You will be its Administrator.
create.failed: The team could not be created. Try again.

problems.not_authenticated: Your session is not valid or has expired. Sign in again.
problems.invalid_name: The team name is not valid. Check it and try again.

dashboard.failed: This team could not be opened.

problems.not_authenticated: Your session is not valid or has expired. Sign in again.
problems.not_a_member: This team does not exist or you do not belong to it.

activate.title: Activate your account
activate.subtitle: Set your password to join the team.
activate.password_hint: At least 12 characters. It cannot be the same as your email or your username.
activate.reasons_title: Your password does not meet the security policy:

reasons.min_length: It must have at least 12 characters.
reasons.not_username: It cannot be the same as your username.
reasons.not_email: It cannot be the same as your email address.
reasons.other: It breaks one of the security rules. Try a longer, different password.

problems.account_exists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in to get in.
problems.unavailable: We could not activate your account right now. Try again in a few minutes.
problems.login_failed: We could not take you to the sign-in. Press the button to try again.

unavailable.title: We could not check your invitation
unavailable.text: The service is not responding right now. Try again in a few minutes.

used.title: This link was already used
used.text: Your account was already activated with this link. If that was you, sign in. If not, ask for a new invitation.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.text: Invitation links are valid for 7 days. Ask for a new invitation to activate your account.

revoked.title: This invitation was cancelled
revoked.text: Whoever invited you no longer has it in force. Ask for a new invitation.

not_found.title: This link is not valid
not_found.text: The link is incomplete or was changed. Open it again from the invitation email.

request_result.sent: Done: we told your team's admins so they can send you a new invitation.
request_result.no_admins: Your team has no active admins to tell. Contact whoever invited you.
request_result.still_valid: Your invitation is still valid. Open the link in the email to activate your account.
request_result.unavailable: We could not send the notice. Try again.

activate.ask_admin: If the problem continues, ask your admin for a new invitation.

not_found.title: We could not find this organization
not_found.text: Check the address or open the link your organization sent you. If the problem continues, ask your administrator for help.
